articles.author: Haaretz
articles.title: Heavy explosions, IDF shelling reported in south Lebanon
articles.description: Lebanon's National News Agency reported Israeli shelling in Mansouri, Majdal Zoun and Wadi Hassan, with heavy explosions reported in the towns of Baraachit and Haddatha
articles.content: Israeli forces shelled areas of southern Lebanon, including Mansouri, Majdal Zoun and Wadi Hassan, in the early hours of Saturday, Lebanon's National News Agency reported.
